SELECT v.Name, v.Age 
FROM visitor v 
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, MAX(Num_of_Ticket) as MaxTickets
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
) v2 ON v.ID = v2.visitor_ID
JOIN visit vi ON v2.visitor_ID = vi.visitor_ID AND v2.MaxTickets = vi.Num_of_Ticket

SELECT v.Name
FROM visitor v
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID
    FROM visit
    JOIN museum m ON visit.Museum_ID = m.Museum_ID
    WHERE m.Open_Year < '2009'
    UNION
    SELECT visitor_ID
    FROM visit
    JOIN museum m ON visit.Museum_ID = m.Museum_ID
    WHERE m.Open_Year > '2011'
) subq ON v.ID = subq.visitor_ID
GROUP BY v.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.Open_Year < '2009' THEN m.Open_Year ELSE NULL END) > 0
AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.Open_Year > '2011' THEN m.Open_Year ELSE NULL END) > 0;
